ways.label: Takahue Saddle Road to Makene Road

start.name: junction of Takahue Saddle Road and Warner Road
start.quote: The track starts at the junction of Takahue Saddle Road and Warner Road.

end.name: Makene Road
end.quote: The track ends at Makene Road.

via.name: old Takahue Saddle Road
via.quote: Follow the old Takahue Saddle Road as it climbs up the hill.

via.name: Raetea Forest
via.quote: The track then enters Raetea Forest

via.name: Mt Raetea
via.quote: the summit of Mt Raetea (744 m)

via.name: 727 m high point
via.quote: There is another a track junction at the 727 m high point.

ways.time: 10-12 hr (allow extra time, may take much longer in poor track and weather conditions)
evidence: The track starts at the junction of Takahue Saddle Road and Warner Road.
The track ends at Makene Road.
If you need transport back to Kaitaia, arrange this before you go.

ways.label: Alternative track exit via Mangamuka Summit Track

start.name: junction of Takahue Saddle Road and Warner Road
start.quote: The track starts at the junction of Takahue Saddle Road and Warner Road.

end.name: SH1 in Mangamuka Gorge
end.quote: end at SH1 in Mangamuka Gorge

via.name: old Takahue Saddle Road
via.quote: Follow the old Takahue Saddle Road as it climbs up the hill.

via.name: Mt Raetea
via.quote: the summit of Mt Raetea (744 m)

via.name: 727 m high point
via.quote: turn left at the 727 m high point

via.name: Mangamuka Summit Track
via.quote: follow the Mangamuka Summit Track down through podocarp forest

evidence: Alternative track exit: turn left at the 727 m high point and follow the Mangamuka Summit Track down through podocarp forest to end at SH1 in Mangamuka Gorge.

doubts: No feature for the start (Takahue Saddle Road / Warner Road junction) or the end (Makene Road). The alternative exit is recorded as its own way (another end) rather than an exit.
